live.what_is_live: 0 of 8 ships from AIS (name, IMO, MMSI, size, draught, destination, ETA, last position); tide from Open-Meteo marine sea-level forecast, calibrated to the Chittagong table, for 195 of 195 h; sunrise and sunset computed for the plan date.
live.what_is_not_live: AISStream has no receiver at Chattogram, so ships are heard in Singapore, the Malacca Strait or Colombo and dead-reckoned from there; berth occupancy at the plan start, terminal assignment, box counts and the yard level are not published and are estimated or assumed.

rules.source: 10 m / 200 m: CPA, reported 5 Feb 2023; movements 4-5 h before high water: P&I club guidance

tide_detail.source: Open-Meteo marine sea-level forecast, calibrated to the Chittagong table, for 195 of 195 h

calibration.fitted_on: 35 published highs and lows for Chittagong, 13-23 Nov 2026 (tide-forecast.com, datum MLLW)

live.tide_note: Tide: Open-Meteo marine sea-level forecast, calibrated to the Chittagong table, for 195 of 195 h. Gates keep a 0.11 m margin for the calibration error. The calibrated model and the harmonic fit differ by 0.17 m RMS over the plan.

baseline_rule: no first-come-first-served plan fits the horizon; the optimised plan is shown in its place

ships.why: waits 5 h for the tide or daylight gate (first open hour 27); held 18 h after cargo for the outbound tide or daylight gate

berths on arrival; held 7 h after cargo for the outbound tide or daylight gate

eta_sigma_h.basis: assumption until the backtest has enough arrivals

assumptions.background: steady state: earlier calls' imports leave and later calls' exports arrive at this plan's average rates
assumptions.cycle_curve: same yard-crane curve as the DES

ledger.status: not settled: the next step does not clear the queue inside the horizon; the last feasible round is shown
